title: Blastub Aeronautics
description: A modpack focused on taking to the skies and telling a great story
body: A server dedicated to taking to the skies and telling a great story with friends. Players can create airships with Create Aeronautics and the new Sable physics engine, conquer magick and mystery with Ars Nouveu and Iron's Spells and Spellbooks, and master technology with the Mekanisn and Create mods.
